issue.title: [Bug]: aws_bedrockagentcore_memory_strategy fails with "Value Conversion Error" on configuration.type (OverrideType) for SUMMARY_OVERRIDE strategies
issue.body:
### Terraform and AWS Provider Version

```console
Terraform Core Version
1.15.8

AWS Provider Version
6.47.0
```

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

`aws_bedrockagentcore_memory_strategy`

### Expected Behavior

A CUSTOM memory strategy configured with a SUMMARY_OVERRIDE configuration block (built-in strategy with a custom consolidation prompt) should plan and apply cleanly, and should be readable back into state on subsequent plans/refreshes.

### Actual Behavior

Any operation that materializes the resource into the provider's type model — `plan`, `apply` (post-create read-back), or refresh of existing state — fails with a `Value Conversion Error` on `configuration[0].type`. The provider receives a `null` value for the `OverrideType` field and cannot decode it.

The failure occurs during state/response decode, so it is not avoidable via -`refresh=false` (prior state is still decoded) or `lifecycle { ignore_changes = ... }` (the error precedes diff computation). Built-in strategies without a `configuration` block (e.g. `type = "SEMANTIC`") are unaffected, because there is no `OverrideType` to decode.

### Relevant Error/Panic Output

```
│ Error:   : Value Conversion Error
│
│   with aws_bedrockagentcore_memory_strategy.short_term_room[0],
│   on agentcore-memory.tf line 62, in resource "aws_bedrockagentcore_memory_strategy" "short_term_room":
│   62: resource "aws_bedrockagentcore_memory_strategy" "short_term_room" {
│
│ Cause: An unexpected error was encountered trying to build a value. This is
│ always an error in the provider. Please report the following to the provider
│ developer:
│
│ Received null value, however the target type cannot handle null values. Use
│ the corresponding `types` package type, a pointer type or a custom type that
│ handles null values.
│
│ Path: configuration[0].type
│ Target Type: types.OverrideType
│ Suggested `types` Type: types.StringEnum[github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/bedrockagentcorecontrol/types.OverrideType]
│ Suggested Pointer Type: *types.OverrideType

```


### Sample Terraform Configuration

<details open>
<summary>Click to expand configuration</summary>

```
resource "aws_iam_role" "memory_exec" {
  name = "agentcore-memory-exec-repro"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect    = "Allow"
      Principal = { Service = "bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com" }
      Action    = "sts:AssumeRole"
    }]
  })
}

resource "aws_bedrockagentcore_memory" "short_term_room" {
  name                      = "repro_short_term_room_memory"
  description               = "Repro - short-term room memory"
  memory_execution_role_arn = aws_iam_role.memory_exec.arn
  event_expiry_duration     = 7
}

resource "aws_bedrockagentcore_memory_strategy" "short_term_room" {
  name        = "room_session_summary_strategy"
  description = "Summarises recent conversation with a custom English-only consolidation prompt"
  memory_id   = aws_bedrockagentcore_memory.short_term_room.id
  type        = "CUSTOM"

  namespaces = ["rooms/{actorId}/sessions/{sessionId}/"]

  memory_execution_role_arn = aws_iam_role.memory_exec.arn

  configuration {
    type = "SUMMARY_OVERRIDE"

    consolidation {
      append_to_prompt = "Always summarize in English regardless of the input language."
      model_id         = "eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0"
    }
  }
}

```
</details>


### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to Reproduce
`terraform apply` the configuration above. The strategy is created in AWS, but the post-create read-back fails with the `Value Conversion Error` above (the resource may be left created in AWS but absent/tainted in state).
Alternatively, for a strategy already present in state, run `terraform plan` — it fails on the same decode while reading prior state (also fails with `-refresh=false`).

### Debug Logging

<details open>
<summary>Click to expand log output</summary>

```console

```
</details>


### GenAI / LLM Assisted Development

n/a

### Important Facts and References

Important Factoids

- The equivalent built-in strategy (`type = "SEMANTIC"`, no configuration block) works fine, isolating the issue to the `configuration.type (OverrideType)` decode path used by the `*_OVERRIDE` strategy types.
- The API/CloudFormation model supports `SUMMARY_OVERRIDE` with a `consolidation` block, so the configuration itself is valid — this appears to be a provider-side decode issue where a null `OverrideType` from the API response cannot be handled.
Workaround: use a built-in `type = "SUMMARIZATION"` strategy with no `configuration` block, which sidesteps the decode path but loses the custom consolidation prompt.

### Would you like to implement a fix?

No
